Let's start there. TextKit uses a four-layer architecture for text rendering.
At the base is the TextStorage layer.
This encapsulates all the text data to be rendered.
The Layout layer sits on top of the text storage.
It's responsible for breaking the text into chunks for rendering.
Next is the Viewport layer.

At the top is the View layer.
